text:
Maria G: Quick ping — PR https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pull/49877 is ready for review. It changes the model routing fallback + adds a short runbook for canary/rollback. Need runtime infra + security ack before I schedule merge. cc @Simon P @Kai I @Olga (Security) :wave:
Simon P: I can take runtime review today. Do we have a canary window in mind? Any perf regressions expected?
Maria G: thanks Simon. Canary window proposal: Wed 10:00–11:30 PT. Expected perf: negligible at p50, small token throughput drop in p95 for the first 2 minutes while caches warm. Fallback remains to the previous model variant.
Olga (Security): quick look from security side — need to confirm no new KMS/HSM keys are introduced and that audit logging covers the fallback path. Can you paste the runbook snippet here?
Maria G: runbook snippet below:
```
Canary plan:
- Merge during quiet window (09:30 PT), hold until approvals
- Deploy canary to 5% traffic for 10m, monitor latency/errored requests
- If errors > 0.5% or p95 latency > baseline + 40%, abort and rollback to model-v2
- Rollback: trigger orch rollback job and invalidate prefix cache via /admin/cache/invalidate
- Postmortem: if rollback occurs, collect KV cache metrics and trace ids
```
Simon P: thx. I want a quick note on metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, token/sec, cache-miss-rate, and request error-rate. I'll add a canary dashboard.
Kai I: infra ok but please ensure autoscaler floor is high enough for spikes during canary warmup. Also confirm the rollout doesn't change node selectors (we had a pod eviction issue last month).
Maria G: confirmed — autoscaler floor bumped for the canary and no node selector changes. I'll attach the autoscale patch in the PR.
Olga (Security): KMS check: no new keys, using existing customer-managed key. Audit logging path verified. Security: +1 conditional on the dashboard and the autoscale floor confirmation.
ci-bot: CI checks passed: unit tests ✅, integration smoke ✅, canary-health-checks pending.
Simon P: I can owner the runtime canary monitoring during the window. Will watch dashboards and escalate if thresholds breach.
Kai I: infra ack. I'll be on call during the window for quick scaling or rollback ops.
Maria G: great — final ask: if we have all three acks by EOD today I will schedule the merge for 09:30 PT tomorrow and start the canary at 10:00 PT. Please react with :thumbsup: if you confirm.
Simon P: :+1:
Olga (Security): :thumbsup:
Kai I: :thumbsup:
Maria G: thanks all — I'll update the PR and add the canary dashboard link. Leaving this thread open for any quick Qs. :rocket:
